entity.name: Johan Larsson
entity.description: Johan Larsson is a postdoctoral researcher in statistics and machine learning and an open-source developer. He develops and maintains Panache, an authoring tool for Markdown and its flavors.

projects.name: Panache
projects.description: Panache is a language server, formatter, and linter for Quarto and other Markdown flavors, including MyST, mdsvex, R Markdown, and Pandoc Markdown. It combines a lossless parser with editor, command-line, and CI tooling. Panache is distributed through Cargo, Homebrew, Nixpkgs, npm, and PyPI, and offers a VS Code extension. Funding would support external language servers for code blocks, bringing language-aware editor features to code embedded in documents.

plans.name: External language servers for code blocks
plans.description: Implement support for attaching external language servers to fenced code blocks, including mapping positions and diagnostics between embedded code and the host document so editors can provide language-aware features within Markdown, Quarto, MyST, mdsvex, and R Markdown.
